en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard view of a riverfront cityscape with a bridge crossing the water and hills rising behind the town. On the left is a riverside promenade with streetlamps and a tall church tower. In the center a metal bridge spans the river on trestle supports, leading toward densely packed buildings and, higher on the hill, a large rectangular complex identified as Castel San Pietro. The caption at the bottom reads in Italian that the scene is Verona, featuring Ponte Umberto and Castel S. Pietro.
